content_html:
1. Rlly interesting what he talked about getting your coworkers to know your family and stuff. It improves your image, and make them understand why you don't want to work fucking 100hr week.

2. Basically, if you ahve clear priorities, you're gonna follow them no matter what. People will know it. If you don't have them (and here it is hard to fake, you need to have them) people are just going to assume that you would be willing to work as much possible. And this is true. This is not about changing how people view you (kind of). It is about changing how you view yourself and your priorities.

3. You can fake some shit (and u know this well), but mostly, they are going to see you how you are.
